notes.title: The Tales of Bayun — release stream
notes.notes:
Alongside with The Tales of Bayun launch we stream the very beginning of the first episode once again!

Wanna unfold the story in your own way, huh? Then try the demo!

Want even more? The full game is out now!

notes.title: Just a few hours until the release!
notes.notes:
The Tales of Bayun will release on February 16 at 7:00 AM (UTC).

It has been an arduous but awesome journey for our team and we are proud of the upcoming game. It is made by fans of narrative-driven games for those who love fascinating stories, interesting characters and hard choices. Hope you will like it, too! 

See you soon at the Side!

notes.title: The Tales of Bayun — release date
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we are finally ready to announce the release date.

The Tales of Bayun will go live on the 16th February 2023. 

In fact both episodes are complete and the game is playable from the beginning till the very end. But localization, testing and polishing are still to be done. Moreover releasing a title at the end of December / the beginning of January will result in competing with many AAA products and different games from the winter sales. 

We will spend the remaining time to guarantee the best quality of The Tales of Bayun and to implement some ideas and improvements that we could not even start due to the lack of time. Yet more information and pleasant surprises are about to come, so stay tuned. Once again, thank you all for the support and interest in our debut game — this means a lot for our team!

notes.title: The Tales of Bayun — demo update, event results and new information
notes.notes:
While other people try to disguise themselves into vampires, witches and other supernatural creatures, our team works our  tail off with The Tales of Bayun. And we have some information to share!

First of all, we’ve once again updated the demo: added a new map, descriptions, dialogue lines and even several dialogue branches, updated animations, visual effects and fixed some bugs. 

Secondly, we have finally summarized the Streamers and Video-makers event. This time the winner is Anna Shepard, congratulations! We’ve also decided to honor DamRiele, Victoria Engine and GamerDotCom for their previous videos, thank you for such amazing content. All mentioned creators will receive The Tales of Bayun Steam key at the time of the full release.

Thirdly, we decided to keep the Streamers initiative going. From time to time we will browse related YouTube videos and award the most appealing to our team authors with free game keys. Perhaps, one of those will be given to you!

Finally, we are ready to pull back the curtain on The Tales of Bayun second episode. Here is the very first screenshot! Do you have any suggestions about the plot or the characters? Feel free to discuss them! We will share even more information later on, but as for now — have a great Halloween!
